name: HG18-b475-script (batch 475)
text: All the instructions you have given me to carry me deeper into this session or keep me in this state are now finished, the only intention I will take with me into my everyday life or the only cue I will use to take me into this state at a later date will be the one I consciously choose to and neither of them will keep me in this state. When I come out of this session I will be me, in my body and with my adult judgment.”
why: Emulate's sample bo for the script's last three sentences, red in place in recheck A3 (Low); the reader's one-word fix ("intention")

name: HG18-b475-count (batch 475)
text: Then do a count up: On 1 start to feel your body again and what it’s resting on and feel your weight (of your choice). On 2 start to feel your breathing return to normal. On 3 start to hear the room around you and name where you are. On 4 start to wiggle your fingers and toes, move your shoulders and your eyes. On 5 open your eyes, back in the here and now, feeling normal and clear and the session is now over.
why: Emulate's sample bp for the count up, red in A3 (Low, Medium), with four of my meaning fixes from the published guide

name: HG18-b475-reorient (batch 475)
text: When you come out make sure you can name what day (or date) it is, look to your left and right, look at something near to you and something further away.
why: Emulate's sample bo for the first three lines after the count, red in A3 (Low), with the reader's two-word fix ("can name"); batch 474's splice of this paragraph read red in place

name: HG18-b475-note (batch 475)
text: Note: If you are going to sleep to a recording then it is fine to go to sleep or just remain resting quietly at the end of it, however if you are coming out of a recording then you should not leave yourself in an altered state, this includes leaving yourself in a role, with lowered judgment, with lowered ability to move, blank or with a non-specific reset word or for an indefinite length of time.
why: Emulate's sample bo for the Note, red in A3 (Medium) in its second sentence

name: neighbour: the script's first three sentences
text: Here is a generic bring-back that you can use: “When I come out of this session, I will only bring with me that which is useful to me in my everyday life right now. Anything else I will bring with me at a later date, when I am better able to integrate it. When I come out of this session, I will be coming back to the room I am in now, and to the day in which I am participating in this session now.

text: Move around a bit. Don’t get up until you feel like you can do so without falling over. Make sure that you are oriented and alert (counting does this, but not always). Take mental note of only what actually came up for you and any actions you need to take regarding it. Then go on and do something normal.
